The position of the update-bit is configurable by configuration parameter ComUp- dateBitPosition . ComUpdateBitPosition is included within the configuration container ComSignal . Hence, it is ensured that the signal / signal group and the corresponding update-bit are always part of the same I-PDU. 80 of 259 Document ID 15: AUTOSAR_CP_SWS_COM Specification of Communication AUTOSAR CP R25-11 [SWS_Com_00055] Upstream requirements: SRS_Com_02030 The AUTOSAR COM module shall handle the update-bit only internally and not as part of the signal or signal group.

Update Bit Excluded in case of Transmission Repe- titions For I-PDUs with transmission mode DIRECT or MIXED with ComTxModeNum- berOfRepetitions greater or equal 1 no update-bit ( ComUpdateBitPosition ) shall be configured.
